title: Basic Router Configuration
objective: Configure basic settings on a Cisco router including hostname, passwords, and interfaces.

steps.desc: Access the router CLI and enter privileged EXEC mode
Configure VTY lines for remote access

qa.q: What command enters privileged EXEC mode?
qa.a: The 'enable' command is used to enter privileged EXEC mode from user EXEC mode.

qa.q: What is the difference between enable password and enable secret?
qa.a: The enable secret is more secure because it uses MD5 encryption, while enable password stores the password in clear text.

qa.q: How many VTY lines are typically available on a Cisco router?
qa.a: Cisco routers typically have 5 VTY lines (0-4) for remote access via Telnet or SSH.
